A ticket or crash report showing no West Virginia liability insurance can suspend your license and registration plate, repeat offenses lengthen the license suspension, and reinstatement requires current proof of insurance plus mandatory reinstatement fees.

Under the Non-Resident Violator Compact a driver may accept a citation for certain violations and continue on, and each member state agrees to suspend its own citizens who fail to comply with the terms of a violation committed in another state.

why_how.text: The privilege to drive carries many responsibilities, you and only you are responsible for your actions, and a license holder must know the requirements that keep the privilege of driving in West Virginia.

If your school notifies the DMV that you are not attending or have excessive unexcused absences, the DMV restricts your license to work, medical, educational and religious purposes until you turn eighteen or present a reinstatement authorization form from the school and pay the reinstatement fee.

To refer an immediate family member who can no longer drive safely, write a detailed explanation to the DMV Medical Section giving the person's name, address, date of birth and license number if possible, and law enforcement or the person's physician may also submit such information.

After an unsafe-driver referral the DMV may reexamine the person's driving skills or request updated medical information from the doctor, and may then issue a restricted license or revoke the driving privilege for everyone's safety.

You may be required to take a medical, written or driving examination when the Commissioner of Motor Vehicles has good cause to believe you are incompetent or otherwise not qualified, the result may be suspension, revocation or a restricted license, and refusing the examination is itself grounds for suspension or revocation.
A referral about an unsafe family member can lead the DMV to reexamine that driver, and refusing a required re-examination is by itself grounds for suspension or revocation.
